Evidence: Uttarakhand High Court ne Char Dham Yatra ko kholne ke liye sarkar ke faisle ko stay kiya hai, yeh kehkar ki yatra se logon ki jaan khatre mein pad sakti hai, khaas taur par Delta Plus variant aur COVID-19 ke teesre leher ke dauran (Source 3). Court ne kaha ki yatra ko rokna zaroori hai, aur yeh faisla Article 21 aur anya constitutional provisions ke khilaf hai (Source 3). Isliye, yatra December mein kholne ka koi faisla nahi hua hai, aur Supreme Court ne bhi is par koi turant faisla nahi sunaaya hai (Source 1).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh saaf hai ki Uttarakhand High Court ne Char Dham Yatra ko kholne ka faisla stay kiya hai, jo claim ke core assertion ko contradict karta hai. Court ne yeh bhi kaha ki yatra se logon ki jaan khatre mein pad sakti hai, aur isliye yeh yatra abhi nahi khuli hai. Isliye, claim ki sachai ko support nahi milta, aur yeh refute hota hai.
